compaction_rule: When the window shrinks (compaction), estimated_context_growth_tokens is null and compaction_detected is true. A negative delta is flagged, never silently recorded.
cost_rule: cost_usd is always null with unpriced_reason. Muse Spark is unpriced in Trckr (not on the providers' pricing pages), so cost is null, never 0 — $0 is reserved for self-hosted runs. Shipping unpriced is acceptable; inventing a price is not.

example_record.note: first record: growth unknown, not zero
example_record.unpriced_reason: muse-spark is unpriced in Trckr (not on the providers' pricing pages); cost is null with this reason, never 0 — $0 is reserved for self-hosted runs

method: estimated_context_growth: the context-window size is recorded whole as context_tokens (the input figure until Meta exposes real per-turn usage). estimated_context_growth_tokens is the window's growth since the previous record — an estimate, NOT a turn's input/output/cache split and NOT turn tokens. Every turn re-bills the full context, so the delta understates real input processing; do not price from this file or from any delta in it.
note: SCHEMA / EXAMPLE ONLY — this file holds no live turn records and no mutable runtime state. Dav1d/Muse Spark turns are not reported to Trckr by Meta; records are built by muse-connector/bin/turns.py (growth_record) from session_status context-window sizes. Runtime state (previous context size, last record/request ids, timestamps) lives in the gitignored muse-connector/state/dav1d-turns.json or in Trckr itself via trckr_session — never in this file.
